ns2:course.label: Educational Statistics
ns2:course.description: (EDPSY 390) Designed for terminal value for professional training of students not intending to pursue advanced graduate work, and for introductory value for students continuing graduate study in education; descriptive statistics, introduction to correlation and regression, the normal curve, statistical inference, and the presentation and interpretation of statistical data in educational literature. 3 undergraduate hours. 4 graduate hours. Prerequisite: Junior standing.
